notes.title: Farm Together 2 - Full release available now!
notes.notes:
Today we're releasing Farm Together 2, the farming experience that anyone can play!

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/6860297/d1125bb8df0734a02d6bcd99c9466df705f8edae.jpg

We've made a huge effort to create a fun and relaxed farming experience. We hope you have a good time playing it!


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2418520/Farm_Together_2/

This couldn't have been done without the help of the community! We really want to thank you for the useful feedback that has helped shape the game during the whole year it's been on Early Access. We've done a total of 91 updates so far, polishing the game and adding new content. And this is just the beginning! Expect new things in the future, including free content updates and seasonal events.

The game will feature a 7-day 10% discount, which can be combined with additional discounts by getting it on a bundle if you already had the first game, or an even better discount if you own the whole Milkstone collection!

notes.title: OSX/Linux update
notes.notes:
Hi!

Thanks to the help of Ethan Lee "flibitijibibo" , we've released an updated version of Little Racers STREET that should work out of the box with modern versions of OSX and Linux distributions, without any workaround required.

Enjoy!

notes.title: Bugfix update - online issues
notes.notes:
Welcome back fellow speed maniacs, it's been a while (2 years since the last patch)!

We've just uploaded a small bugfix update that should help with a specific issue regarding not being able to join online sessions, as well as another one regarding getting stuck in the car selection screen when joining an online game and not having a car for the required class.
